title.zh: 重新划拨第2093号共和国法第一编M部分f段莱特省第232页第II组第28目（ak）项所拨2500比索的法案
title.en: An Act Reappropriating the Sum of Two Thousand Five Hundred Pesos Appropriated Under Item (ak), Page 232, Group II, Subparagraph 28, for the Province of Leyte, Paragraph f, Title M, Section One of Republic Act Numbered Two Thousand Ninety-Three
title.orig: An Act Reappropriating the Sum of Two Thousand Five Hundred Pesos Appropriated Under Item (ak), Page 232, Group II, Subparagraph 28, for the Province of Leyte, Paragraph f, Title M, Section One of Republic Act Numbered Two Thousand Ninety-Three

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2886_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The sum of two thousand five hundred pesos appropriated under item (ak), page 232, group II, subparagraph 28, for the Province of Leyte, paragraph f, Title M, Section one of Republic Act Numbered Two thousand ninety-three, to wit:
"(ak) Victory Barrio School, Matalom Construction and/or improvement ₱2,500.00" is hereby reappropriated for the construction of a school building in the barrio of Taylan, Municipality of Matalom, Province of Leyte.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
